node.statement: Constant ledger and arbitrary-data setup. Let C_prod,e_prod and C_diag,e_diag be universal witnesses from lem-hcb2-product-defect and lem-hcb3-diagonal-lower-modulus, and let e_adj be the threshold from lem-hcb2-amplified-adjointness. Unpack the universal O(e) constant in the registered compressed-product-display as C_cp<infinity with a universal validity threshold e_cp>0. Put B=1+C_cp, A=max{1,C_diag+B+C_prod}, C_rect=2*A, and e_rect=min{e_adj,e_prod,e_diag,e_cp,1/(2*A)}. Fix an H-CB datum with e<=e_rect satisfying the two hypotheses, an arbitrary n>=1, and write T_n=(Ha^Q_{P,R})_n and D_n=(Ha^Q_{R,R})_n. These constants are universal, C_rect<infinity, e_rect>0, and A*e<=1/2.
